title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 18. Notes the Ombudsman’s commitment to fundamental rights; notes that the Ombudsman asked for greater transparency with regard to the human rights information considered before signing the EU-Tunisia Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), while recalling the strategic importance of cooperation with non-EU countries in combating illegal migration and human trafficking;
